title: GraphSteal: Structural Knowledge Stealing from Graph RAG via Traversal Reconstruction
authors: Jinze Gu; Qinghua Mao; Xi Lin; Jun Wu
why_relevant: Proposes a black-box extraction attack against Graph RAG that reconstructs the underlying knowledge graph, exposing a privacy attack surface relevant to adversarial threats on RAG systems.
why_not_or_caveat: Focuses on privacy/structural extraction rather than poisoning, injection, or robustness of generation; narrower fit to the survey's adversarial-corruption theme.
suggested_section: Adversarial Corruption and Attacks on RAG
